This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly.   export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

16	## 2. 前置知识
17	
18	### 2.1 EAGLE-3 是什么（直觉）
19	
20	u6-l1 把投机解码建模为 decode 循环上的乐观并发事务：草稿器（drafter）先提出 K 个草稿 token，目标模型一次前向验证 K+1 个位置，接受规则取最长匹配前缀并附加一个修正/奖励 token。草稿器越「猜得准」，每轮提交的 token 越多。
21	
22	EAGLE-3 是一种**利用目标模型自身隐藏态**的草稿器思路：目标模型每一层都会产生隐藏态（hidden state，即残差流 residual stream——逐层累加更新的特征向量），深层隐藏态已经包含了「接下来最可能输出什么」的大量信息。EAGLE-3 从目标的浅/中/深三个位置各取一份隐藏态，拼接后用一个小的单层「midlayer」草稿网络把它们融合，直接预测下一个 token。因为输入信息量大，这个单层草稿器能达到可观的接受率，而它的前向代价远小于目标模型。
23	
24	对照同 crate 的另外两个草稿器（u6-l2～u6-l4）：DFlash 用单层 fc + 层缓存做提案，DSpark 在其上叠加 Markov 头；它们与本讲共享 u6-l1 的事务核心、目标隐藏态捕获管线与 `draft_ready_requests` ready 集，只是 worker 车道不同——`DraftModel` 枚举按 checkpoint 路径二选一（u1-l4）。

54	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
55	
56	### 4.1 aux_hidden_state_layers：三层捕获索引换算
57	
58	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
59	
60	EAGLE-3 需要从目标模型的**浅（low）、中（mid）、深（high）**三个位置各捕获一份 post-layer 隐藏态，拼接成 `fc` 的输入（`3 * hidden` 列）。问题在于：「第几层」有两种数法。
61	
62	- 上游 SafeAILab 的 `traineagle3` 训练代码以 `(2, N/2, N-3)` 为门槛，但它在**运行这些层之前**追加残差流——也就是说它取的是「进入第 ℓ 层之前的残差流」；
63	- vLLM 用 post-layer 的 `idx + 1` 捕获实现了同一语义；
64	- 本 crate 的捕获路径（`prefill.rs` 与 `verify_graph.rs`）是 **0 基、post-layer** 的：捕获点「块 i 的输出」。
65	
66	「进入上游第 ℓ 层的残差流」就是「第 ℓ−1 块（0 基）的输出」。因此同样的三股残差流，在我们的坐标下每个索引都要**前移一块**：
67	
68	\[
69	(2,\ N/2,\ N-3) \;\longrightarrow\; (1,\ \lfloor N/2 \rfloor - 1,\ N-4)
70	\]
71	
72	对 36 层的 Qwen3-4B：\( N = 36 \)，得 \( (1, 17, 32) \)。这段换算的依据记录在代码注释里（含 PR #662 讨论），见 [src/eagle3.rs:L26-L35](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L26-L35)。
73	
74	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
75	
76	```text
77	aux_hidden_state_layers(N):
78	    low  = 1
79	    mid  = saturating(N/2 - 1)
80	    high = saturating(N - 4)
81	    确保 low < mid < high < N      # 否则报错：三层必须严格递增且落在层范围内
82	    返回 [low, mid, high]
83	```
84	
85	校验失败意味着目标层数太少，放不下一个严格递增的三元组——这是硬失败（装载草稿器时直接报错），不是静默降级。

102	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
103	
104	**练习 1**：为什么本 crate 的 high 是 `N - 4` 而上游是 `N - 3`？
105	**答案**：上游索引指「进入该层的残差流」，等于上一块的输出；我们的捕获点是 0 基 post-layer 输出，所以每个索引减一，`N - 3` 变 `N - 4`。两个约定描述的是同一股残差流。
106	
107	**练习 2**：如果目标只有 7 层，换算结果还能用吗？
108	**答案**：能。`(1, 2, 3)` 严格递增且 3 < 7，校验通过——但层数太少时浅/中/深的区分度存疑，实践中 EAGLE-3 草稿器都是配深目标模型的。
109	
110	**练习 3**：为什么用 `saturating_sub` 而不是直接 `-`？
111	**答案**：小 N（如 N=2）时 `N/2 - 1` 与 `N - 4` 会下溢。饱和成 0 后交给 `ensure!` 拒绝，能得到一条带具体数值的错误信息，而不是一个 `usize` 减法溢出 panic。

113	### 4.2 Eagle3DraftModel：fc 融合、单层 midlayer 与 d2t 词表重映射
114	
115	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
116	
117	`Eagle3DraftModel` 是一个**极小**的自回归草稿网络，全部组成件：
118	
119	1. **`fc`**：`[hidden, 3*hidden]` 矩阵，把捕获的浅/中/深三层目标隐藏态融合成一份 `[hidden]` 的「融合目标隐藏态」；
120	2. **`midlayer`**：单个解码器块。与目标的 `TransformerBlock` 有两处承重差异——注意力输入是 `2 * hidden_size`（EAGLE-3 把 `[input_layernorm(embed), hidden_norm(fused_hidden)]` 拼接后再过 q/k/v），且**没有 QK-norm**；
121	3. **`norm` + `lm_head`**：最终 RMSNorm 之后在**缩小词表**（`draft_vocab_size`，如 32 000）上出 logits；
122	4. **`d2t`**：长度为 `draft_vocab_size` 的 `i64` 偏移表，`target_id = draft_id + d2t[draft_id]`，把草稿 id 映射回目标词表；
123	5. **`cos_cache` / `sin_cache`**：草稿自己的 RoPE 表。
124	
125	注意它**不存词嵌入**：checkpoint 不带 embedding，前向时复用目标模型的 `embed_tokens`（见 4.4 的 `draft_step`）。缩小词表让 `lm_head` 这一步 GEMM 小很多——代价只是每次映射查一次表。
126	
127	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
128	
129	装载流程（`from_safetensors_for_target`）：
130	
131	```text
132	读 config.json → Eagle3Config
133	validate_for_target(target.config)          # 跨配置硬校验
134	load_shard_info → mmap → deserialize        # 与目标装载同一套 weight_loader
135	逐张量 load_tensor_2d/1d + vstack：
136	    q/k/v_proj   [*, 2*hidden]  → qkv_proj（行堆叠）
137	    gate/up_proj [inter, hidden] → gate_up_proj（行堆叠）
138	    fc           [hidden, 3*hidden]
139	    lm_head      [draft_vocab, hidden]
140	    d2t / t2d    主机侧表（只做长度校验）
141	precompute_rope(max_position_embeddings, rope_theta)
142	```
143	
144	显存预留（`Eagle3MemoryReservation`）把草稿器的开销拆成两条账：
145	
146	\[
147	\text{kv\_bytes\_per\_token} = \text{num\_hidden\_layers} \times 2 \times \text{kv\_dim} \times 2\text{B}
148	\]
149	
150	（只有单层草稿 K/V 随池子规模增长，经 `effective_bytes_per_block` 记在 KV 预算上），以及 `fixed_bytes` = 权重（+10% 余量）+ 两条 RoPE 表 + prefill/decode 稠密 scratch + 捕获特征缓冲，记在 memory margin 上。

189	### 4.3 Eagle3RequestState 与 Eagle3Scratch：请求状态与单 token 缓冲
190	
191	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
192	
193	EAGLE-3 的草稿侧状态分两层：
194	
195	- **`Eagle3RequestState`（每请求、跨前向持久）**：草稿自己那**一层**的 K/V cache（`[kv_dim, max_cache_len]` 两条）、`cached_len`（已写入列数）、`max_cache_len`，以及 `last_aux_hidden_states`——「边界特征」，即最后一个已提交位置上的 `[3*hidden, 1]` **pre-fc** 目标特征。它是本轮链式 rollout 的出发信号。
196	- **`Eagle3Scratch`（每 lane 一份、单 token）**：`draft_step` 的全部中间激活，**所有缓冲 `seq_len == 1`**，外加 argmax 的 split-partials 缓冲。v1 一次跑一个请求、一次一个 token，所以形状全部定死、一次分配、跨请求跨轮次复用。
197	
198	分工的好处：请求状态只随请求数增长（且只有 K/V 是大块），scratch 与批宽无关——这正是 `EAGLE3_MAX_BATCH = 1` 的物质基础。
199	
200	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
201	
202	```text
203	new_request_state(max_cache_len):
204	    确保 1 <= max_cache_len <= config.max_position_embeddings
205	    分配 k, v: [kv_dim, max_cache_len]（零初始化）
206	    cached_len = 0, last_aux_hidden_states = None
207	
208	new_scratch():
209	    对每个中间量按 [dim, 1] 零分配（见下表）
210	    argmax partials 长度 = argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len(1, draft_vocab)
211	```
212	
213	scratch 各缓冲的形状注记直接写在字段旁（[src/eagle3/forward.rs:L34-L60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3/forward.rs#L34-L60)）：`argmax_*` 四条是设备侧 argmax 的工作区，`token_id_d` 是当前 token id 的设备侧落点，其余从 `embed` 到 `logits` 一路是单列激活。

244	### 4.4 prefill_prompt 与 chain_round：整段建 cache 与 γ=3 链式 rollout
245	
246	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
247	
248	草稿器的前向分三个入口，对应请求生命周期的三段：
249	
250	1. **`prefill_prompt`（prompt 刚过完目标 prefill）**：用捕获的整段目标特征 teacher-force 地把草稿 KV 一次建好，并把最后一个特征留作边界。核心是 **EAGLE 特征↔token 错位配对**：把特征 \( f_j \)（目标在第 j 个 token 上的输出）与**下一个** token 的词嵌入 \( e_{j+1} \) 配对，预测 \( t_{j+2} \)。也就是说：草稿在槽位 j 上「看着位置 j-1 的目标特征、吃着位置 j 的 token」，去预测位置 j+1 的 token。
251	2. **`chain_round`（每轮投机）**：从边界特征出发，自回归地滚 γ=3 步链：每步出 logits → 设备上 argmax → 读回 id → `d2t` 映射成目标 id → 作为下一步输入。链上写的 KV 是**投机的**，轮末把 `cached_len` 回退到起点，使轮次除返回 token 外无副作用。
252	3. **`rebuild_after_verify`（verify 之后）**：见 4.5。
253	
254	链长受 `chain_capacity` 约束：
255	
256	\[
257	k = \min\left(\gamma,\ \max\left(0,\ L_{\max} - C - 1\right)\right)
258	\]
259	
260	那个 `+1` 是投机解码的**奖励 token**：全接受的轮会提交 γ 个草稿加 1 个 verify 自产 token，所以 cache 必须给 \( C + k + 1 \) 留满槽。
261	
262	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
263	
264	**`draft_step`（链上一步，全部 `seq_len == 1`）**：
265	
266	```text
267	写入 token_id → 复用目标 embed_tokens 得 embed          [hidden, 1]
268	normed_embed  = rms_norm(embed,  input_layernorm)
269	normed_hidden = rms_norm(hidden, hidden_norm)            # hidden 是上一步的残差流
270	attn_input    = [normed_embed ‖ normed_hidden]           [2*hidden, 1]
271	q, k, v       = qkv_proj 行段 GEMM                        [q_dim|kv_dim|kv_dim, 1]
272	rope(q, k, position)                                     # 无 QK-norm 的朴素 RoPE
273	state.k/v 第 position 列 ← k, v；kv_len = position + 1
274	attn_out      = single_decode(q; state.k, state.v)        [q_dim, 1]
275	o             = o_proj @ attn_out；hidden += o            （fused_add_rms_norm）
276	gate, up, act = MLP(normed_post)；mlp_out = down_proj @ act；hidden += mlp_out
277	logits        = lm_head @ rms_norm(hidden, norm)          [draft_vocab, 1]
278	state.cached_len = kv_len
279	```
280	
281	**`chain_round`**：
282	
283	```text
284	start = cached_len；k = chain_capacity(start, L_max, γ)；k == 0 则本轮跳过
285	fused = fc(last_aux_hidden_states)                        # 初始化残差流
286	span  = draft_chain(...)：循环 k 次 { draft_step; argmax; 读回; d2t; 喂回 }
287	cached_len = start                                        # 丢弃投机 KV
288	返回 span（k 个目标词表 id）
289	```
290	
291	**`prefill_prompt`**：
292	
293	```text
294	要求 p >= 2 且 cached_len == 0（v1 需要整段 prompt 一个 chunk）
295	feat = 捕获列 [offset, offset+p-1)                        # f_0..f_{P-2}
296	prefill_batched(feat, tokens = prompt[1..p], start = 0)   # P-1 个错位对
297	last_aux_hidden_states = 捕获列 offset+p-1                # f_{P-1} 留作边界
298	```
299

353	### 4.5 rebuild_after_verify：接受前缀后的状态重建
354	
355	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
356	
357	verify 之后，目标模型给出两样东西：接受了多少个草稿（`matched_draft_tokens = n`），以及 verify span 上每个位置的目标隐藏态（捕获列）。`rebuild_after_verify` 用它们把草稿状态推进到「最后一个已提交位置」：
358	
359	- 提交的草稿前缀是 `[current, d_1..d_n]`（n+1 个 token，`current` 是本轮入口 token）；verify 的奖励 token 不进草稿 KV——它成为下一轮的 `current_token`。
360	- 重建 = 把这 n+1 个 (特征, token) 错位对 teacher-force 进槽 `[C, C+n+1)`，其中第一个特征用**旧边界**（位置 C-1 的目标特征），其后用 verify 捕获的第 0..n-1 列；
361	- **新边界** = verify 捕获的第 n 列——最后一个已提交位置上的目标特征。下一轮链将以 `(新边界, 奖励 token)` 起跳，预测再下一个 token。
362	
363	为什么可以直接覆写而不清理缓存？被链污染的列要么被这次重建覆写，要么位于 `cached_len` 之外——而 `draft_step` 写槽之前只会读 `[0..=position]` 且 `position == cached_len`，所以陈旧列在被读之前必然已被后续步骤覆写。
364	
365	#### 4.5.2 核心流程
366	
367	```text
368	n = matched_draft_tokens; len = n + 1
369	校验: len <= span_tokens.len()（span = [current, d_1..d_γ]）
370	      captured.dim == 3*hidden; token_offset + n < captured.seq_len
371	feat = [旧边界 (1 列) ‖ captured[offset .. offset+n) (n 列)]     # n+1 列
372	prefill_batched(feat, tokens = span_tokens[..n+1], start = cached_len)
373	last_aux_hidden_states = captured[offset + n]                    # 新边界
374	```

429	## 6. 本讲小结
430	
431	- **捕获层换算**：上游 `(2, N/2, N-3)` 指「进入该层的残差流」，本 crate 0 基 post-layer 捕获等价于 `(1, N/2-1, N-4)`；36 层目标得 `[1, 17, 32]`，配严格递增硬校验。
432	- **模型结构**：`fc` 把三层目标特征融合成 `[hidden]`；单层 midlayer 的注意力吃 `[2*hidden]` 拼接输入且无 QK-norm；词嵌入复用目标；logits 出在缩小词表上、经主机侧 `d2t` 映射回目标词表。
433	- **状态分层**：`Eagle3RequestState` 只存单层 K/V、`cached_len` 与 pre-fc 边界特征；`Eagle3Scratch` 全部 `seq_len == 1`、一次分配跨轮复用——`EAGLE3_MAX_BATCH = 1` 的物质基础。
434	- **三个入口**：`prefill_prompt` 以 `(f_j, e_{j+1})` 错位对整段建 KV 并留边界；`chain_round` 用 `fc(边界)` 起跳、γ=3 逐步 argmax 链、轮末回退 `cached_len` 使轮次无副作用；`rebuild_after_verify` 按接受前缀 teacher-force 重建 `[C, C+n+1)` 并把边界推进到最后已提交位置。
435	- **容量公式**：\( k = \min(\gamma, L_{\max} - C - 1) \)，`+1` 为奖励 token；它与 rebuild 最多写到槽 `C+k` 的需求精确咬合。
436	- **每轮一次同步**：argmax 在设备、`d2t` 在主机，v1 每个草稿读回一次 id——已知的性能取舍。

# EAGLE-3 草稿器：捕获层换算与前向 rollout

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 推导 EAGLE-3 的三个目标层捕获索引：为什么上游约定 `(2, N/2, N-3)` 在本 crate 的 0 基 post-layer 捕获路径上等价于 `(1, N/2-1, N-4)`，并能对 36 层的 Qwen3-4B 算出 `[1, 17, 32]`。
2. 说出 `Eagle3DraftModel` 的全部组成件：`fc` 融合矩阵、单层 `midlayer`（注意力输入是 `2 * hidden_size`、无 QK-norm）、复用目标模型的词嵌入、缩小词表上的 `lm_head` 与 `d2t` 主机侧重映射表。
3. 解释 `Eagle3RequestState`（每请求的单层 K/V cache + 边界特征）与 `Eagle3Scratch`（全部 `seq_len == 1` 的临时缓冲）的分工。
4. 手推一次 γ=3 的 `chain_round` 链式 rollout：embed 拼接 → qkv → RoPE → attention → o_proj → MLP → logits → argmax → 喂回下一 token，并写出每步张量形状。
5. 推导 `chain_capacity` 在 `cached_len` 逼近 `max_cache_len` 时返回的 k，理解 `+1` 是投机解码的奖励（bonus）token。
6. 理解 `rebuild_after_verify` 在接受前缀后如何用 verify 捕获的目标隐藏态 teacher-force 重建草稿 KV 与边界特征。

本讲只到 `forward.rs` 的三个入口（`prefill_prompt` / `chain_round` / `rebuild_after_verify`）为止；它们被谁、在什么门控下调用，属于 u6-l8（EAGLE-3 车道与门控）的内容。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 EAGLE-3 是什么（直觉）

u6-l1 把投机解码建模为 decode 循环上的乐观并发事务：草稿器（drafter）先提出 K 个草稿 token，目标模型一次前向验证 K+1 个位置，接受规则取最长匹配前缀并附加一个修正/奖励 token。草稿器越「猜得准」，每轮提交的 token 越多。

EAGLE-3 是一种**利用目标模型自身隐藏态**的草稿器思路：目标模型每一层都会产生隐藏态（hidden state，即残差流 residual stream——逐层累加更新的特征向量），深层隐藏态已经包含了「接下来最可能输出什么」的大量信息。EAGLE-3 从目标的浅/中/深三个位置各取一份隐藏态，拼接后用一个小的单层「midlayer」草稿网络把它们融合，直接预测下一个 token。因为输入信息量大，这个单层草稿器能达到可观的接受率，而它的前向代价远小于目标模型。

对照同 crate 的另外两个草稿器（u6-l2～u6-l4）：DFlash 用单层 fc + 层缓存做提案，DSpark 在其上叠加 Markov 头；它们与本讲共享 u6-l1 的事务核心、目标隐藏态捕获管线与 `draft_ready_requests` ready 集，只是 worker 车道不同——`DraftModel` 枚举按 checkpoint 路径二选一（u1-l4）。

### 2.2 你需要携带的既有概念

| 概念 | 出处 | 本讲怎么用 |
|---|---|---|
| 投机事务：propose → verify → accept，verify span = K+1 | u6-l1 | γ = `EAGLE3_CHAIN_LENGTH` = 3，span = 4 |
| 草稿/验证边界是纯 token 跨界，proposer 隐藏态不越线 | u6-l1 | 本讲的「跨界」例外是**目标侧**捕获特征，它由目标前向产出、喂给草稿器 |
| `DraftMeta` 能力位（`max_draft_batch` 等） | u3-l1 / u1-l4 | `EAGLE3_MAX_BATCH = 1` 由此上报 |
| GQA：`q_dim = num_heads * head_dim`，`kv_dim = num_kv_heads * head_dim` | u2-l2 | 草稿 midlayer 沿用目标的注意力几何 |
| RoPE 位置编码 | u2-l1 | 草稿用自己的 `cos/sin_cache`，`rope_theta` 必须与目标一致 |
| teacher forcing（教师强制） | 通用 | 用真实 token 而非草稿自己的输出跑前向，只为了把 K/V 写进 cache |
| `HiddenStates` 布局：`[hidden_dim, seq_len]`，一列一个 token | u2-l2 | 本讲所有形状都按「行数 × 列数」书写 |

术语约定：本讲用 \( C \) 表示 `state.cached_len`（已提交位置数），\( L_{\max} \) 表示 `state.max_cache_len`（该请求草稿 cache 的总槽位数），\( \gamma = 3 \) 表示链长，\( P \) 表示 prompt token 数，\( N \) 表示目标模型层数。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 | 本讲视角 |
|---|---|---|
| `src/eagle3.rs` | 模块根：γ 与 max batch 常量、`aux_hidden_state_layers` 捕获层换算、`Eagle3Layer` / `Eagle3DraftModel` 结构体 | 4.1、4.2 |
| `src/eagle3/forward.rs` | 前向实现：`chain_capacity`、`Eagle3RequestState` / `Eagle3Scratch`、`draft_step` / `draft_chain` / `prefill_batched` / `prefill_prompt` / `chain_round` / `rebuild_after_verify` | 4.3、4.4、4.5 |
| `src/eagle3/loading.rs` | 从 safetensors 装载草稿权重，几何对目标校验 | 4.2 |
| `src/eagle3/reservation.rs` | 草稿器显存预留（`kv_bytes_per_token` + `fixed_bytes`） | 4.2、4.3 |
| `src/config.rs` | `Eagle3Config` 解析与 `validate_for_target` 跨配置校验 | 4.2 |
| `src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs` | 三个入口的调用方（车道集成） | 仅引用行号，详讲在 u6-l8 |
| `tests/eagle3_speculative_gate.rs` | EAGLE-3 无损性行为门测试 | 4.4 实践对照 |

模块根的声明与导出见 [src/eagle3.rs:L1-L15](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L1-L15)：头两行点名了典型 checkpoint（`AngelSlim/Qwen3-4B_eagle3`），三个子模块 `forward` / `loading` / `reservation`，向 crate 内导出 `Eagle3RequestState`、`Eagle3Scratch` 与 `Eagle3MemoryReservation`。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 aux_hidden_state_layers：三层捕获索引换算

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

EAGLE-3 需要从目标模型的**浅（low）、中（mid）、深（high）**三个位置各捕获一份 post-layer 隐藏态，拼接成 `fc` 的输入（`3 * hidden` 列）。问题在于：「第几层」有两种数法。

- 上游 SafeAILab 的 `traineagle3` 训练代码以 `(2, N/2, N-3)` 为门槛，但它在**运行这些层之前**追加残差流——也就是说它取的是「进入第 ℓ 层之前的残差流」；
- vLLM 用 post-layer 的 `idx + 1` 捕获实现了同一语义；
- 本 crate 的捕获路径（`prefill.rs` 与 `verify_graph.rs`）是 **0 基、post-layer** 的：捕获点「块 i 的输出」。

「进入上游第 ℓ 层的残差流」就是「第 ℓ−1 块（0 基）的输出」。因此同样的三股残差流，在我们的坐标下每个索引都要**前移一块**：

\[
(2,\ N/2,\ N-3) \;\longrightarrow\; (1,\ \lfloor N/2 \rfloor - 1,\ N-4)
\]

对 36 层的 Qwen3-4B：\( N = 36 \)，得 \( (1, 17, 32) \)。这段换算的依据记录在代码注释里（含 PR #662 讨论），见 [src/eagle3.rs:L26-L35](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L26-L35)。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
aux_hidden_state_layers(N):
    low  = 1
    mid  = saturating(N/2 - 1)
    high = saturating(N - 4)
    确保 low < mid < high < N      # 否则报错：三层必须严格递增且落在层范围内
    返回 [low, mid, high]
```

校验失败意味着目标层数太少，放不下一个严格递增的三元组——这是硬失败（装载草稿器时直接报错），不是静默降级。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

函数本体在 [src/eagle3.rs:L36-L46](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L36-L46)：两个 `saturating_sub` 保证小 N 时不发生算术下溢 panic，而是得到一个必然违反严格递增的三元组，再被 `ensure!` 用带具体数值的错误信息拒绝。配套单测 [src/eagle3.rs:L97-L102](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L97-L102) 验证 N=6（得 `(1,2,2)`，mid 不小于 high）与 N=4（得 `(1,1,0)`，low 不小于 mid）都被拒绝。

这个三元组在装载期由车道计算并保存：`load_eagle3` 用**目标**配置的 `num_hidden_layers` 调用它（[src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs:L60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs#L60)），存进 `Eagle3LaneState.aux_layers`（[src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs:L30-L36](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs#L30-L36)），再经 `aux_layers()` 暴露给捕获路径挑选目标层。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：手工验证捕获层换算，并跑通本模块的纯 CPU 单测。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 对 \( N \in \{4, 6, 7, 8, 36, 40\} \) 逐个算出 `(low, mid, high)` 并判断能否通过严格递增校验；
   - 运行 `cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --lib eagle3`（过滤串会匹配 `eagle3::tests::aux_layers_reject_tiny_target`、`eagle3::forward::tests::chain_shrinks_at_cache_edge`、`eagle3::reservation::tests::eagle3_reservation_pins_geometry` 三个纯 CPU 单测的完整路径）。
3. **需要观察的现象**：N=4 与 N=6 的用例被拒绝；其余通过。
4. **预期结果**：N=7 → `(1,2,3)` 通过；N=8 → `(1,3,4)` 通过；N=36 → `(1,17,32)`；N=40 → `(1,19,36)`。三条单测全部 pass。（命令未在本讲义生成环境中执行，属常规 `--lib` 单测入口，可本地验证。）

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么本 crate 的 high 是 `N - 4` 而上游是 `N - 3`？
**答案**：上游索引指「进入该层的残差流」，等于上一块的输出；我们的捕获点是 0 基 post-layer 输出，所以每个索引减一，`N - 3` 变 `N - 4`。两个约定描述的是同一股残差流。

**练习 2**：如果目标只有 7 层，换算结果还能用吗？
**答案**：能。`(1, 2, 3)` 严格递增且 3 < 7，校验通过——但层数太少时浅/中/深的区分度存疑，实践中 EAGLE-3 草稿器都是配深目标模型的。

**练习 3**：为什么用 `saturating_sub` 而不是直接 `-`？
**答案**：小 N（如 N=2）时 `N/2 - 1` 与 `N - 4` 会下溢。饱和成 0 后交给 `ensure!` 拒绝，能得到一条带具体数值的错误信息，而不是一个 `usize` 减法溢出 panic。

### 4.2 Eagle3DraftModel：fc 融合、单层 midlayer 与 d2t 词表重映射

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`Eagle3DraftModel` 是一个**极小**的自回归草稿网络，全部组成件：

1. **`fc`**：`[hidden, 3*hidden]` 矩阵，把捕获的浅/中/深三层目标隐藏态融合成一份 `[hidden]` 的「融合目标隐藏态」；
2. **`midlayer`**：单个解码器块。与目标的 `TransformerBlock` 有两处承重差异——注意力输入是 `2 * hidden_size`（EAGLE-3 把 `[input_layernorm(embed), hidden_norm(fused_hidden)]` 拼接后再过 q/k/v），且**没有 QK-norm**；
3. **`norm` + `lm_head`**：最终 RMSNorm 之后在**缩小词表**（`draft_vocab_size`，如 32 000）上出 logits；
4. **`d2t`**：长度为 `draft_vocab_size` 的 `i64` 偏移表，`target_id = draft_id + d2t[draft_id]`，把草稿 id 映射回目标词表；
5. **`cos_cache` / `sin_cache`**：草稿自己的 RoPE 表。

注意它**不存词嵌入**：checkpoint 不带 embedding，前向时复用目标模型的 `embed_tokens`（见 4.4 的 `draft_step`）。缩小词表让 `lm_head` 这一步 GEMM 小很多——代价只是每次映射查一次表。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

装载流程（`from_safetensors_for_target`）：

```text
读 config.json → Eagle3Config
validate_for_target(target.config)          # 跨配置硬校验
load_shard_info → mmap → deserialize        # 与目标装载同一套 weight_loader
逐张量 load_tensor_2d/1d + vstack：
    q/k/v_proj   [*, 2*hidden]  → qkv_proj（行堆叠）
    gate/up_proj [inter, hidden] → gate_up_proj（行堆叠）
    fc           [hidden, 3*hidden]
    lm_head      [draft_vocab, hidden]
    d2t / t2d    主机侧表（只做长度校验）
precompute_rope(max_position_embeddings, rope_theta)
```

显存预留（`Eagle3MemoryReservation`）把草稿器的开销拆成两条账：

\[
\text{kv\_bytes\_per\_token} = \text{num\_hidden\_layers} \times 2 \times \text{kv\_dim} \times 2\text{B}
\]

（只有单层草稿 K/V 随池子规模增长，经 `effective_bytes_per_block` 记在 KV 预算上），以及 `fixed_bytes` = 权重（+10% 余量）+ 两条 RoPE 表 + prefill/decode 稠密 scratch + 捕获特征缓冲，记在 memory margin 上。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

- **结构体**：[src/eagle3.rs:L48-L72](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L48-L72) 是 `Eagle3Layer`，注释明确两处与目标块的差异（`2 * hidden_size` 输入、无 QK-norm）；[src/eagle3.rs:L74-L91](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L74-L91) 是 `Eagle3DraftModel`，`d2t` 的注释点明它是主机常驻的小查表、不是 GEMM 输入。两个常量在 [src/eagle3.rs:L17-L24](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3.rs#L17-L24)：γ=3 且「v1 是固定 top-1 **链**，不是树」；`EAGLE3_MAX_BATCH = 1` 且 v1 用单 token scratch，更大批次由调度器退回纯解码（呼应 u4-l2 的 `max_draft_batch` 门）。

### 4.3 Eagle3RequestState 与 Eagle3Scratch：请求状态与单 token 缓冲

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

EAGLE-3 的草稿侧状态分两层：

- **`Eagle3RequestState`（每请求、跨前向持久）**：草稿自己那**一层**的 K/V cache（`[kv_dim, max_cache_len]` 两条）、`cached_len`（已写入列数）、`max_cache_len`，以及 `last_aux_hidden_states`——「边界特征」，即最后一个已提交位置上的 `[3*hidden, 1]` **pre-fc** 目标特征。它是本轮链式 rollout 的出发信号。
- **`Eagle3Scratch`（每 lane 一份、单 token）**：`draft_step` 的全部中间激活，**所有缓冲 `seq_len == 1`**，外加 argmax 的 split-partials 缓冲。v1 一次跑一个请求、一次一个 token，所以形状全部定死、一次分配、跨请求跨轮次复用。

分工的好处：请求状态只随请求数增长（且只有 K/V 是大块），scratch 与批宽无关——这正是 `EAGLE3_MAX_BATCH = 1` 的物质基础。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
new_request_state(max_cache_len):
    确保 1 <= max_cache_len <= config.max_position_embeddings
    分配 k, v: [kv_dim, max_cache_len]（零初始化）
    cached_len = 0, last_aux_hidden_states = None

new_scratch():
    对每个中间量按 [dim, 1] 零分配（见下表）
    argmax partials 长度 = argmax_batch_bf16_split_partials_len(1, draft_vocab)
```

scratch 各缓冲的形状注记直接写在字段旁（[src/eagle3/forward.rs:L34-L60](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3/forward.rs#L34-L60)）：`argmax_*` 四条是设备侧 argmax 的工作区，`token_id_d` 是当前 token id 的设备侧落点，其余从 `embed` 到 `logits` 一路是单列激活。

### 4.4 prefill_prompt 与 chain_round：整段建 cache 与 γ=3 链式 rollout

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

草稿器的前向分三个入口，对应请求生命周期的三段：

1. **`prefill_prompt`（prompt 刚过完目标 prefill）**：用捕获的整段目标特征 teacher-force 地把草稿 KV 一次建好，并把最后一个特征留作边界。核心是 **EAGLE 特征↔token 错位配对**：把特征 \( f_j \)（目标在第 j 个 token 上的输出）与**下一个** token 的词嵌入 \( e_{j+1} \) 配对，预测 \( t_{j+2} \)。也就是说：草稿在槽位 j 上「看着位置 j-1 的目标特征、吃着位置 j 的 token」，去预测位置 j+1 的 token。
2. **`chain_round`（每轮投机）**：从边界特征出发，自回归地滚 γ=3 步链：每步出 logits → 设备上 argmax → 读回 id → `d2t` 映射成目标 id → 作为下一步输入。链上写的 KV 是**投机的**，轮末把 `cached_len` 回退到起点，使轮次除返回 token 外无副作用。
3. **`rebuild_after_verify`（verify 之后）**：见 4.5。

链长受 `chain_capacity` 约束：

\[
k = \min\left(\gamma,\ \max\left(0,\ L_{\max} - C - 1\right)\right)
\]

那个 `+1` 是投机解码的**奖励 token**：全接受的轮会提交 γ 个草稿加 1 个 verify 自产 token，所以 cache 必须给 \( C + k + 1 \) 留满槽。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

**`draft_step`（链上一步，全部 `seq_len == 1`）**：

```text
写入 token_id → 复用目标 embed_tokens 得 embed          [hidden, 1]
normed_embed  = rms_norm(embed,  input_layernorm)
normed_hidden = rms_norm(hidden, hidden_norm)            # hidden 是上一步的残差流
attn_input    = [normed_embed ‖ normed_hidden]           [2*hidden, 1]
q, k, v       = qkv_proj 行段 GEMM                        [q_dim|kv_dim|kv_dim, 1]
rope(q, k, position)                                     # 无 QK-norm 的朴素 RoPE
state.k/v 第 position 列 ← k, v；kv_len = position + 1
attn_out      = single_decode(q; state.k, state.v)        [q_dim, 1]
o             = o_proj @ attn_out；hidden += o            （fused_add_rms_norm）
gate, up, act = MLP(normed_post)；mlp_out = down_proj @ act；hidden += mlp_out
logits        = lm_head @ rms_norm(hidden, norm)          [draft_vocab, 1]
state.cached_len = kv_len
```

**`chain_round`**：

```text
start = cached_len；k = chain_capacity(start, L_max, γ)；k == 0 则本轮跳过
fused = fc(last_aux_hidden_states)                        # 初始化残差流
span  = draft_chain(...)：循环 k 次 { draft_step; argmax; 读回; d2t; 喂回 }
cached_len = start                                        # 丢弃投机 KV
返回 span（k 个目标词表 id）
```

**`prefill_prompt`**：

```text
要求 p >= 2 且 cached_len == 0（v1 需要整段 prompt 一个 chunk）
feat = 捕获列 [offset, offset+p-1)                        # f_0..f_{P-2}
prefill_batched(feat, tokens = prompt[1..p], start = 0)   # P-1 个错位对
last_aux_hidden_states = 捕获列 offset+p-1                # f_{P-1} 留作边界
```

### 4.5 rebuild_after_verify：接受前缀后的状态重建

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

verify 之后，目标模型给出两样东西：接受了多少个草稿（`matched_draft_tokens = n`），以及 verify span 上每个位置的目标隐藏态（捕获列）。`rebuild_after_verify` 用它们把草稿状态推进到「最后一个已提交位置」：

- 提交的草稿前缀是 `[current, d_1..d_n]`（n+1 个 token，`current` 是本轮入口 token）；verify 的奖励 token 不进草稿 KV——它成为下一轮的 `current_token`。
- 重建 = 把这 n+1 个 (特征, token) 错位对 teacher-force 进槽 `[C, C+n+1)`，其中第一个特征用**旧边界**（位置 C-1 的目标特征），其后用 verify 捕获的第 0..n-1 列；
- **新边界** = verify 捕获的第 n 列——最后一个已提交位置上的目标特征。下一轮链将以 `(新边界, 奖励 token)` 起跳，预测再下一个 token。

为什么可以直接覆写而不清理缓存？被链污染的列要么被这次重建覆写，要么位于 `cached_len` 之外——而 `draft_step` 写槽之前只会读 `[0..=position]` 且 `position == cached_len`，所以陈旧列在被读之前必然已被后续步骤覆写。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

```text
n = matched_draft_tokens; len = n + 1
校验: len <= span_tokens.len()（span = [current, d_1..d_γ]）
      captured.dim == 3*hidden; token_offset + n < captured.seq_len
feat = [旧边界 (1 列) ‖ captured[offset .. offset+n) (n 列)]     # n+1 列
prefill_batched(feat, tokens = span_tokens[..n+1], start = cached_len)
last_aux_hidden_states = captured[offset + n]                    # 新边界
```

#### 4.5.3 源码精读

函数在 [src/eagle3/forward.rs:L605-L669](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3/forward.rs#L605-L669)：

- 三条前置校验（[L615-L637](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3/forward.rs#L615-L637)）：span 足够长（`1 bonus + k drafts`）、捕获维度匹配 fc、需要的捕获列存在——注意边界列要读到 `token_offset + n`，所以校验是 `<`（需要第 n 列存在）。
- 错位拼接（[L640-L652](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3/forward.rs#L640-L652)）：注释把 feat 写成 `[boundary f_{pos-1} ‖ f_pos..f_{pos+n-1}]`，共 n+1 列；n=0 时只有旧边界一列。
- teacher-force 与新边界（[L653-L667](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/eagle3/forward.rs#L653-L667)）：`prefill_batched` 把提交前缀写进 `[C, C+n+1)`；新边界取捕获列 `token_offset + n`，注释「the target feature at the last committed position」。
- 调用方 `record_verify_eagle3_context` 逐请求调它，`token_offset` 沿捕获缓冲累加（[src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs:L205-L228](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor/eagle3_lane.rs#L205-L228)）。

与 `chain_capacity` 的呼应：n 最大取 k，重建最多写到槽 `C+k`（含），所以需要 \( C + k + 1 \le L_{\max} \)——正是 4.4 那个 `+1` 的来源。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **捕获层换算**：上游 `(2, N/2, N-3)` 指「进入该层的残差流」，本 crate 0 基 post-layer 捕获等价于 `(1, N/2-1, N-4)`；36 层目标得 `[1, 17, 32]`，配严格递增硬校验。
- **模型结构**：`fc` 把三层目标特征融合成 `[hidden]`；单层 midlayer 的注意力吃 `[2*hidden]` 拼接输入且无 QK-norm；词嵌入复用目标；logits 出在缩小词表上、经主机侧 `d2t` 映射回目标词表。
